key_concepts: Agricultural, industrial, and medical biotechnology have different applications
Biotechnology can treat diseases and increase economic value
Biotechnology may raise ethical issues and reduce biodiversity
Traditional biotechnology includes selective breeding and fermentation
Modern biotechnology includes recombinant DNA and mutagenesis
A population is a group of organisms of the same species living in the same place at the s
Population size is the number of individuals in a population
Population density is the average number of individuals per unit area or volume
Natality, mortality, immigration, and emigration change population size
Exponential growth changes at a rate proportional to population size
Logistic growth begins gradually and then increases as the population grows
Demography is the statistical study of human populations
